settings.title: Sustainability & Self-love
settings.body:
Like our ancestors, we practise kaitiakitanga, guardianship and reciprocal care for the world around us. We favour natural materials, slower processes and makers who create with integrity and care.

Self-love is self-care. The greatest thing we can offer those around us is our own wholeness, so we support the daily rituals that bring care, connection and presence into everyday life.

settings.title: Empowering Women & The Art of Gifting
settings.body:
Empowering women is essential to the wellbeing of families, communities and future generations. By supporting women-owned businesses, we nurture creativity, collaboration and a more connected, conscious way of doing business.

Gifting is an ancient ritual of love and connection, one that doesn't need to come at the expense of the planet. Our sustainable gift boxes are designed to bring comfort, beauty and meaning to every occasion.

settings.hero_title: A place to pause. A place to reconnect. A place to feel inspired.
settings.story_body:
Tea & Tonic began in 2017, founded by dear friends Monni and Aysha. It started with a simple wish: to create a calm, meaningful space devoted to wellbeing, filled with teas, tonics and the small rituals that bring us back to ourselves.

Along the way, we noticed something. So many of the products we loved most were made by women. Herbalists, jewellers, perfumers, artists and makers, often handmaking from home, weaving love into every creation.

Today, Tea & Tonic exists to champion these women. We look for integrity in ingredients and materials, honesty in how things are made, and a story worth telling.
settings.offer_body:
Our store is home to natural skincare, botanical perfume and herbal tea, alongside jewellery, ceramics, crystals, natural fibre clothing, art, homewares, candles and sustainable gifts.

Each piece favours natural materials, thoughtful craftsmanship and timeless design. Many are women-led, artist-created, locally made or small-batch, reflecting a slower, more intentional approach to both consumption and creation.

In store, our skilled and caring team also offers holistic wellbeing treatments, including Reiki and energy healing.
settings.creations_body:
Tea & Tonic is also where you'll find Monni's own creations. MONNI Label is her New Zealand-made clothing line crafted from natural fibres, and MONNI Art is her original artwork and prints, created using botanical plant inks.

MONNI Botanicals is a seasonal skincare line made in deep collaboration with The Herbologist. Organically grown botanicals are harvested in rhythm with the seasons and moon cycles, then slowly infused into small-batch, seed-to-bottle formulations. Because each batch follows the seasons, MONNI Botanicals grows quietly and in its own time.
settings.space_body:
Designed by New Zealand architect Frazer Horton, our store was created to feel grounding, nurturing and connected to nature. Influenced by Eastern design philosophies and surrounded by flowing water and cherry blossom trees, it has become known as a sanctuary that quietly delights the senses and invites people to slow down.

Matakana Village is New Zealand's first Slow Town, part of the international Cittaslow movement, and a community built around independent boutiques, local makers and sustainable living. We're proud to call it home, a place that believes how we live, shop and gather matters.
settings.values_intro:
Our values are grounded in hauora, the Māori philosophy of holistic wellbeing. True wellness lives within our relationships, our rituals, our creativity, our connection to nature, and the way we care for ourselves and others each day.

  • Taha tinana, physical wellbeing and the health of the body
  • Taha hinengaro, mental and emotional wellbeing
  • Taha wairua, spiritual wellbeing and connection to meaning and purpose
  • Taha whānau, connection to family, relationships and community
  • Taha whenua, connection to the land, nature and a sense of belonging

When these parts of ourselves are nurtured together, we move closer towards balance.

settings.founder_body:
I am descended from Ruawaipu, Ngāti Porou, and Te Whānau a Apanui. My ancestors arrived in Aotearoa over a thousand years ago and served as careful guardians of the land for many generations.

They understood the sacred connection between people and the natural world, believing that our physical and spiritual wellbeing depends upon our relationship with the whenua. To honour and continue that legacy is a responsibility I carry deeply. It guides every part of my life and my work.

I am human, as are you. I am energy, as are you, and so is everything that exists within our infinite universe. We reflect one another and learn from each other on this journey. It is my belief that we are all here to walk each other home.

At our core, each of us longs for love, acceptance and belonging. We all know what it feels like to feel unseen, not enough, or disconnected from who we truly are.

Yet here we are, living, breathing and feeling within these miraculous bodies. Even when life feels difficult, this life itself is a gift.

My own path towards self-love was shaped by a moment when I realised the feelings, thoughts and beliefs I held about myself were the opposite of love. We all carry wounds that shape us, but it is not the pain that defines us. It is how we choose to meet ourselves now, and in every moment moving forward.

As we learn to love and accept ourselves more deeply, we begin to love and accept others more fully too. Self-love is not a solitary act. It is an invitation to recognise our shared humanity.

Let go of the 'shoulds', the labels and the conditioning. Deep down, you already know what is true for you. Trust that knowing, and never stop imagining what is possible.

What is the most true and beautiful life you can dream into being?

More than a store, Tea & Tonic is a space for ritual, creativity, wellbeing and conscious living. We look forward to welcoming you into our world and sharing a little tea with you.
